% ADDED figure (2026-11-02): the diagrams of one example box (C6a/C6b/§CA.7); generated by qft-C/tools/c6diag/figs/make_figs.sh
\tikzset{
  fdl/.style={line width=0.8pt, black},
  fdx/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=3.6pt},
  fdv/.style={circle, fill=figB, draw=figB, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt},
  fdlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2.6pt},
  fdmom/.style={->, >=Stealth, figO, line width=0.6pt},
}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},
  fdS/.style={font=\small},
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]
  % row 1: attached to x and y
  % 1 bubble
  \begin{scope}
    \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(0.6,0); \draw[fdl] (1.8,0)--(2.4,0);
    \draw[fdl] (0.6,0) to[bend left=60] (1.8,0); \draw[fdl] (0.6,0) to[bend right=60] (1.8,0);
    \node[fdx] at (0,0){}; \node[fdx] at (2.4,0){}; \node[fdv] at (0.6,0){}; \node[fdv] at (1.8,0){};
    \node[fdlab,above] at (0,0.05){$x$}; \node[fdlab,above] at (2.4,0.05){$y$};
    \node[fdlab,below left] at (0.6,-0.02){$z_1$}; \node[fdlab,below right] at (1.8,-0.02){$z_2$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (1.2,-1.2) {bubble, $S=2$\\[1pt] $\frac12$: $36$ pairings};
  \end{scope}
  % 2 tadpole on the line
  \begin{scope}[xshift=4.5cm]
    \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(2.2,0); \draw[fdl] (1.1,0)--(1.1,0.55); \draw[fdl] (1.1,0.83) circle (0.28);
    \node[fdx] at (0,0){}; \node[fdx] at (2.2,0){}; \node[fdv] at (1.1,0){}; \node[fdv] at (1.1,0.55){};
    \node[fdlab,below] at (0,0){$x$}; \node[fdlab,below] at (2.2,0){$y$};
    \node[fdlab,below] at (1.1,-0.05){$z_1$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.38,0.83){$z_2$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (1.1,-1.2) {tadpole on the line, $S=2$\\[1pt] $\frac12$: $36$};
  \end{scope}
  % 3 two one-point tadpoles
  \begin{scope}[xshift=9.2cm]
    \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(0.8,0); \draw[fdl] (0.8,0.3) circle (0.3);
    \draw[fdl] (2.8,0)--(2.0,0); \draw[fdl] (2.0,0.3) circle (0.3);
    \node[fdx] at (0,0){}; \node[fdx] at (2.8,0){}; \node[fdv] at (0.8,0){}; \node[fdv] at (2.0,0){};
    \node[fdlab,below] at (0,0){$x$}; \node[fdlab,below] at (2.8,0){$y$};
    \node[fdlab,below] at (0.8,-0.05){$z_1$}; \node[fdlab,below] at (2.0,-0.05){$z_2$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (1.4,-1.2) {two one-point tadpoles, $S=4$\\[1pt] $\frac14$: $18$};
  \end{scope}
  % row 2: free line times vacuum bubble
  \begin{scope}[xshift=2.6cm, yshift=-3.1cm]
    \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(2.4,0); \node[fdx] at (0,0){}; \node[fdx] at (2.4,0){};
    \node[fdlab,below] at (0,0){$x$}; \node[fdlab,below] at (2.4,0){$y$};
    \draw[fdl] (0.7,0.8)--(1.7,0.8);
    \draw[fdl] (0.42,0.8) circle (0.28); \draw[fdl] (1.98,0.8) circle (0.28);
    \node[fdv] at (0.7,0.8){}; \node[fdv] at (1.7,0.8){};
    \node[fdlab,above] at (0.92,0.8){$z_1$}; \node[fdlab,above] at (1.48,0.8){$z_2$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (1.2,-1.0) {line $\times$ dumbbell, $S=8$\\[1pt] $\frac18$: $9$};
  \end{scope}
  \begin{scope}[xshift=7.6cm, yshift=-3.1cm]
    \draw[fdl] (0,0)--(2.4,0); \node[fdx] at (0,0){}; \node[fdx] at (2.4,0){};
    \node[fdlab,below] at (0,0){$x$}; \node[fdlab,below] at (2.4,0){$y$};
    \draw[fdl] (0.55,0.8)--(1.85,0.8); \draw[fdl] (0.55,0.8) to[bend left=55] (1.85,0.8); \draw[fdl] (0.55,0.8) to[bend right=55] (1.85,0.8);
    \node[fdv] at (0.55,0.8){}; \node[fdv] at (1.85,0.8){};
    \node[fdlab,left] at (0.48,0.8){$z_1$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.92,0.8){$z_2$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (1.2,-1.0) {line $\times$ theta, $S=12$\\[1pt] $\frac1{12}$: $6$};
  \end{scope}
  \node[fdS,align=center] at (6.2,-5.15) {cubic vertex $-ig$; coefficient $N_D/72$, $|G_2|=2!\,(3!)^2=72$;\quad $36+36+18+9+6=105=7!!$ pairings};
